notes: New: QBR Pack now includes a 'Trend vs. Last Quarter (~90 days ago)' section built from the system_snapshots historical data added in 5.2.0 -- critical/high risk delta, open case delta, efficiency ratio delta, Feature Adoption Score delta, and any ONTAP version upgrades, all compared against each system's closest snapshot from ~90 days back. Contract renewal lines in the QBR now also show a risk-trend note (WORSENING/IMPROVING) so renewal conversations start with current context, not stale numbers. New /api/history/annotate endpoint lets the client append its own Feature Adoption Score computation onto today's snapshot -- deliberately not re-derived in Python, to avoid repeating an earlier bug where three different health-grade formulas gave the same account different letter grades. All of this gracefully says 'not enough history yet' rather than fabricating a comparison when a fleet hasn't synced for 90+ days.
